name: FinalReportAgent
description: Assembles the run's Final Evaluation Report deterministically from Components 1-8 — decision (Compliant / with warnings / Partially / Not compliant / Not assessable), executive summary, what was evaluated, compliance matrix, runtime results with failure screenshots, code-vs-runtime discrepancies, critical findings, gates, recommendations, evidence coverage, limitations and method — rendered as JSON, Markdown and a printable sandboxed HTML page.

inputs.name: score
inputs.description: Compliance scoring result (compliance, interval, gates, risk, depth)

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Traced requirements with verdicts and scores

inputs.name: pass_fail
inputs.description: Runtime verdicts per test and criterion

outputs.name: final_report
outputs.description: {data: report JSON (meta, decision, summary, application, requirements, runtime, discrepancies, findings, gates, recommendations, coverage, limitations, method), markdown, html}
